items.title: Constellation Energy (CEG) Stock Looks Discounted Against Fair Value
items.summary: Constellation Energy stock has had a strong three year run, yet current valuation checks suggest the market price may still sit below what its cash flows and earnings imply. Both an intrinsic value estimate based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach and traditional earnings multiples currently point to an undervalued profile, even after recent share price gains. Constellation Energy has delivered a 163.0% return over the past three years, which puts the recent share price in sharp focus...
